summary: Summit Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 securities purchase agreement with AstraZeneca Holdings B.V., a subsidiary of AstraZeneca plc, for a $2.0 billion private placement of 108,955.3686 newly designated Class A Convertible Preferred shares at $18,356.14 each, convertible 1,000-for-1 into common stock, implying $18.3561 per common share. Closing is expected within five business days subject to customary conditions. The filing also cites preemptive rights and rights upon a third-party acquisition proposal, plus related charter amendments and unregistered-sales disclosure. This is a strategic equity investment, not an acquisition, tender, or going-private event. Watch for conversion overhang, potential strategic control influence, and any subsequent tender or change-of-control activity.
